expected_semantic_slots.objects: A countably infinite family of independent real-valued E_n with unit exponential laws, represented on a genuine probability space. Source starts n>=1; zero-based reindexing is harmless.
expected_semantic_slots.domains: Countable index N and real random variables supported on positive reals; probability measure. No finite sample set, pseudo-law, deterministic selected sequence or process-specific state is adequate.
expected_semantic_slots.quantifiers: Existence of a concrete probability space and sequence realizing the specified laws/independence; almost surely all coordinates are strictly positive and the finite initial sums tend to +infinity. A single common full-measure event for all indices is needed.
expected_semantic_slots.assumptions: No process/cap/clock premise belongs in the input-law leaf. Independent Exp(1) is the source sampling specification, to be realized by the construction rather than added as an unproved public premise for the existence theorem.
expected_semantic_slots.conclusion: Realize independent Exp(1) coordinates and a.s. sum divergence. Strict positivity is an explicit standard consequence of Exp(1) needed to supply the input contract. Source SLLN implies average->1 then partial sums->+infinity.
expected_semantic_slots.scopes_and_senses: Input-law leaf only. Not the well-posedness, nonexplosion, unique process or Markov theorem. Infinite product independence must hold jointly, not just pairwise. Coordinate law may not silently become the law of max(0,E).
expected_semantic_slots.constant_dependencies: Exact rate 1; direct source route uses finite mean exactly 1. Any alternative bounded-indicator SLLN route must prove a strictly positive success probability from the Exp(1) law and remain labelled as an alternative sufficient route.
